answers.rationale: Both carry-on rollers and one checked shared bag can reasonably fit a three-night family trip with jackets and a nicer dinner outfit. The better choice depends on family size, airline baggage rules, willingness to manage the booster in the airport, and preferences about checked-bag risk versus carry-on convenience.

The appropriate plan depends on the folded banner's dimensions, the amount of clothing and printed material, airline carry-on limits, and whether the traveler prioritizes avoiding checked luggage or keeping hands free. A checked bag, carry-on roller, backpack/tote combination, or carrying the banner separately could each be appropriate under different unstated conditions.

Four nights of layered clothes and gifts could support either checking one shared bag or using carry-on rollers. The query does not specify the number of travelers, bag sizes, airline policies, gift volume, or the family's tolerance for managing carry-ons alongside the booster.
